scenes.name: 小微看号
scenes.html:
小微看号
A DIFFERENT VIEW
小微看号
A DIFFERENT VIEW
一次公号体验 · 阿哲Coding小瞬间
我把自己的公众号，交给小微分析了一次。
I asked Xiaowei to look at my WeChat account.
它不仅介绍账号，还开始推荐具体文章。
It introduced the account and suggested articles.
这是小微测试版在这次对话里的表现。
This was one conversation with the test version.

scenes.name: 账号画像
scenes.html:
账号画像
AI AND PRACTICE
账号画像
AI AND PRACTICE
它怎样介绍这个账号
它用AI开发和项目实践，概括我的内容方向。
It described my focus as AI development and practical projects.
换一个视角，我也看到了这个账号留下的特点。
A different view revealed the features my work had left behind.

scenes.name: 从哪读起
scenes.html:
从哪读起
A PLACE TO START
从哪读起
A PLACE TO START
从账号介绍，到阅读起点
推荐的主题里，有世界模型，也有独立开发。
Its suggestions covered world models and independent development.
介绍让人知道这里写什么，推荐让人知道从哪里读起。
An introduction explains the account. Suggestions offer a starting point.

scenes.name: 作者视角
scenes.html:
作者视角
BEYOND THE VERDICT
作者视角
BEYOND THE VERDICT
比一个判断，更值得留意的理由
它还说，几篇文章大概率出自我本人。
It also said several pieces were probably written by me.
我更在意它给出的理由，而不是直接接受这个结论。
I cared more about its reasons than accepting that conclusion.
解释问题的方式、用过的例子，都被注意到了。
It noticed the way I explained ideas and the examples I used.
这次体验，也让我看见了自己的内容，在另一个视角下的轮廓。
The experience let me see the shape of my work from another perspective.
我更在意，它看到了哪些表达上的特点。
